source.publication: 2025 IT-140 Personal Income Tax Forms and Instructions (West Virginia Tax Division), with Schedule M bound in
source.section: IT-140 exemption boxes (a), (b), (e) and line 6 (PDF p.3; instructions PDF p.26 'You can deduct $2,000 for every exemption claimed'); IT-140 lines 1-8 (PDF p.3; instructions PDF p.26: exemptions 2,000 each, line 7 floored at zero); Rate Schedules I and II (PDF p.37); Tax Table (PDF p.38 on)

worked: Married filing jointly, both 49 to 50, wages only: exemption boxes (a) and (b), 2 x 2,000. You (Column A) born 1975-03-01, age 50 at December 31, 2025; Spouse (Column B) born 1976-09-20, age 49 at December 31, 2025. Federal AGI (given) = wages 60,000.00 (you) + wages 30,000.00 (spouse) = 90,000.00. Federal taxable income (given, not tested) = 90,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 = 58,500.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IT-140 line 1 federal AGI 90,000.00. Schedule M additions lines 51-58 none; IT-140 line 2 0.00. Schedule M You (Column A): line 47: age 50, under 65 and not disabled, none; line 49 = 0.00. Schedule M Spouse (Column B): line 47: age 49, under 65 and not disabled, none; line 49 = 0.00. Line 50 total subtractions = 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00. IT-140 line 3 subtractions 0.00; line 4 West Virginia AGI = 90,000.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 90,000.00. Line 5 Low-Income Earned Income Exclusion: federal AGI over 10,000, none. Line 6 exemptions 2 x 2,000.00 = 4,000.00. Line 7 taxable income = 90,000.00 - 4,000.00 = 86,000.00. Line 8 tax by Rate Schedule I (PDF p.37) bands: 2.22% x 10,000.00 = 222 + 2.96% x 15,000.00 = 444 + 3.33% x 15,000.00 = 499.5 + 4.44% x 20,000.00 = 888 + 4.82% x 26,000.00 = 1253.2; total 3306.7 = 3,306.70. The Tax Table row 86,000 to under 86,050 (PDF p.38 on) gives 3,308; expected keeps the schedule formula on the exact income. No Family Tax Credit (Modified Federal AGI above the table limits); credits 0.00; state income tax 3,306.70.
accepted_approximations: Tax below 100,000 of taxable income is figured on the exact income, where the booklet uses a Tax Table row's midpoint rounded to the whole dollar. Other tax is also rounded to the whole dollar in the booklet.
